main_text.l: contrarias fabulas confixere. Eat nunc Vir
doctus, & Basilidi quantum volet affin-
gat quam Menandri dicit esse Syzygiam;
ego Theodoretum sequar, & Basilidem
Menandro cōtraria excogitasse
firmissimè credam. Basilides, pergit eruditus Pearso-
nius, Menandri sententiam non concidit, non
concidit sanè, neque id concedere molé-st-
um erit; sed, inquit in immensum extén-
dit, pace tuâ Vir doctissime in immensum
non extendit, neque de Menandri do-
ctrinâ id dicit Irenæus, à quo hæc verba
accepit Pearsonius, sed de ipsissimo Basili-
dis impio dogmate, ecce Irenæi verba lib.

page.notes: Doubtful readings: "adm serit" (broken type in the line, likely "admiserit"); "negab ꝛ" (the abbreviation after "negab" is unclear, probably "negabit"); "lib. ı." (the numeral is printed as a dotted or dotless i, read as i). Suspected printing error: "Oorntem" (probably "Orontem"), left as printed. The word "sitã" carries a tilde as printed. Italic and roman changes follow the printed type. The fragment "pulum" at the start continues from the previous page. The Google watermark at bottom right is omitted.
